2019 Q1.bq: Revenue per discharge in Q1 increased 2.6% which was above our expectations and resulted from rate increases across all major payer classes and improvements in discharge destination, specifically a decrease in discharge to mix and an increase in discharge to community.

2019 Q4.bq: Adjusted free cash flow for 2019 of $516.5 million dollars was at the top end of our guidance range.

2021 Q1.gq: Our full-year 2021 guidance has been increased to reflect our first quarter results, and the recent legislative action by Congress to extend the Medicare sequestration suspension through the end of the year.

2026 Q1.gq: Based primarily on our Q1 results, we are raising our guidance for 2026.

2026 Q2.gq: Based primarily on our Q2 results, we are again raising our guidance for 2026.

2026 Q3.gq: Based primarily on our Q3 results, we are again raising our guidance for 2026.
